summary: Auna S.A., a Latin American healthcare platform, filed a Form 6-K announcing second-quarter 2026 financial results. The release details revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, and operational metrics, plus expansion initiatives in Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. No special-situation transaction is involved. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer; no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is purely informational and does not warrant classification under any special-situations category.
